subject: 別の女性・ヒグマ・襲撃
evidence: Behind her on the left, an adult brown bear on all fours bursts out of the bamboo, jaws wrenched wide open with fangs bared, ears pinned flat, the fur along its neck bristled, closes the gap in two powerful bounds and lunges onto her back from behind, knocking her forward toward the ground.
reason: 別の女性とヒグマが登場し、背後から襲う瞬間まで描かれている。
